title: Deep Rest Is Not Laziness
creator: Mira Hossain
published: 2026-09-28
---
Most knowledge workers treat rest as the absence of work. This essay argues that deliberate rest, such as long walks, unplugged evenings and a full day off each week, is part of doing good work, not a reward for it.

The author draws on her years running a design studio in Dhaka, where the team moved to a four-day week and shipped more, not less. She ends with three rules: protect the first hour of the day, never take calls after 8pm, and take one full day a week with no screens.
